sentences.text:
PETITION NO.967/2015 Ashish Kumar Agarwal & Anr.
Vs.
State of Rajasthan & Anr.
Date of order : 20.04.2015  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE VIJAY BISHNOI
Mr. Deepak Bishnoi for the petitioners

This criminal misc.
petition under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the petitioners being aggrieved with the order dated 14.03.2015 whereby the Additional District Magistrate-cum- Adjudicating Officer, Sirohi has imposed a fine of Rs.2,00,000/- upon the petitioner-firm in the proceedings under clause (ii) of Sub-Section (2) of Section 26 and Sections 51 and 52 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

entities.text: Additional District Magistrate-cum- Adjudicating Officer, Sirohi
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioners has submitted that expiry date of seized food items was April 2013 whereas for the first time, the petitioner was given notice by the authorized officer in December 2013.

It is contended that right of the petitioners, to ask for sending the remaining part of the seized articles to be analyzed by accredited food laboratory, has been infringed because such opportunity was given to the petitioners after the expiry date of seized articles.
Learned Public Prosecutor accepts notice on behalf of respondent-State.
Record of the Adjudicating Officer be summoned.
Meanwhile, the direction given by the Adjudicating Officer to the petitioner to deposit a fine of Rs.2,00,000/- shall remain stayed.

[VIJAY BISHNOI],J.
Babulal/
